caption:
If you hit a wall around 3 p.m., last night's sleep might be the reason.

So many women push through the afternoon dip with another coffee and a little guilt, assuming it's just how midlife feels. But that heavy, foggy stretch is often less about the afternoon and more about the rest you did (or didn't) get the night before. When sleep comes in broken pieces, your body never fully tops off the tank — and by mid-afternoon, it lets you know.

Here's a gentle tip you can use today: notice your evening the way you notice your morning. The hour before bed shapes the night that follows. Dimming the lights, cooling the room a few degrees, and setting your phone down earlier are small shifts that give your body a clearer signal that rest is coming.

The Midlife Sleep Fix is a supportive workbook that walks you through those shifts step by step — a calming wind-down routine, light and temperature adjustments, and journaling prompts to quiet a busy mind before bed. Nothing extreme. Just steady, doable habits that help your evenings work a little harder for you.

Better afternoons often begin the night before. Start there.

caption:
That 3 p.m. crash? Check your recovery before you blame your discipline.

A lot of men treat the afternoon slump as a willpower problem and reach for more caffeine to muscle through. But when focus drops off a cliff mid-day, it's often the previous night showing up on the invoice. Poor recovery means slower decisions, a shorter fuse, and less drive when you need it most.

Here's a practical tip for today: instead of fighting the dip with another cup, look at the input. What time did the lights go out? How many times did you surface during the night? You can't out-hustle a recovery deficit. You have to close it.

The Sleep Recovery Protocol is a straight-to-the-point workbook that gives you the system: a wind-down sequence, light and temperature settings that support deeper stages, a caffeine and screen cutoff schedule, and tracking templates so you can see what's actually moving the needle. No fluff. Just the levers that matter.

Protect the night and the afternoon takes care of itself.
